title: Better SSH configuration
description: Native better-ssh.json shape, or vscode-sftp-compatible object/array (same as sftp.json).

uploadOnSave.description: Upload the saved file to defaultTargets automatically

cdOnConnect.description: When opening SSH terminal, cd into remotePath if set

transfers.description: Number of file transfers to run in parallel (rclone --transfers)

checkers.description: Number of checkers to run in parallel (rclone --checkers)

defaultTargets.description: Target names used for upload-on-save and default fan-out. Use ["*"] for all.

ignore.description: Glob patterns to skip on upload-on-save / sync (explicit Explorer upload bypasses these)

remotePath.description: Absolute or home-relative path on the remote

context.description: Local subdirectory relative to the workspace (vscode-sftp compatible). Only files under this folder sync to this target.

host.description: SSH hostname or IP (required if sshConfigHost is omitted)

privateKeyPath.description: Path to private key; ~ is expanded

password.description: Deprecated in JSON: prefer VS Code SecretStorage. If present, Better SSH migrates it out of the file on load. Prefer SSH keys when possible.

passphrase.description: Deprecated in JSON: prefer VS Code SecretStorage. Passphrase for an encrypted privateKeyPath; migrated out of the file on load.

hop.description: ProxyJump hosts (used when sshConfigHost is not set)

enabled.description: Set false to keep the target in config but skip upload-on-save / default uploads (e.g. unreachable on current network)

protocol.description: vscode-sftp compat; Better SSH is always SFTP/SSH

uploadOnSave.description: vscode-sftp compat; merged into root uploadOnSave (true if any target sets true)

followSymlinks.description: vscode-sftp compat; ignored by Better SSH

ignore.description: vscode-sftp compat; merged into root ignore
